thread:
priya.k: Heads-up: Pegasus dedicated bring-up scheduled Tue 08:00 PT. Need a quick quota priming + autoscale surge rehearsal before we hand over to the customer. Can ops + eng run the surge plan and confirm runbook + rollback hooks? Link to onboarding notes: https://redwood.internal/pegasus/onboard :eyes:

sam.w: I can run the load script. Do we have the target RPS and model variant? Also want to confirm whether we prime KV/prefix cache or do a cold-start test first.

jordan: Ops will pre-adjust quotas. Plan to set reserved pool to 2x expected concurrency for the rehearsal window. Need pool id and exact endpoints to hit. Also prefer spike-driven test (sustained + short ramp).

elena_r: I'll own observability for the run. Creating a temporary dashboard, SLA alerts, and a quick rollback channel. Will add a canary route so we can shift traffic back if latency regresses. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Maintenance window created: 2024-02-20 08:00-09:30 PT for "pegasus-dedicated-surge-rehearsal". Reminder set 30m prior.

priya.k: Thanks. Targets below — please use staging first, then gated to reserved pool id "pegasus-rsv-03". Model: text-gen-3b-quant (seq_len=512). Load targets: sustained 60 RPS for 20m, spike to 180 RPS for 2m, concurrency target ~120. Priming: run a prefix heat for top-10 prompts for 10m before test. Curl + k6 snippet for the smoke run:```bash
# k6 simple POST scenario
export TARGET_URL=https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate
cat <<'EOF' > k6-script.js
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export let options = { vus: 50, duration: '10m' };
export default function() {
  http.post(__ENV.TARGET_URL, JSON.stringify({ model: 'text-gen-3b-quant', prompt: 'Prime: summarize user message' }), { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer $TEST_KEY' }});
  sleep(0.5);
}
EOF
k6 run k6-script.js
```

sam.w: Got it — will run smoke in staging tonight and schedule the full rehearsal for Tue. I'll capture priming logs and note any cold-start anomalies. ETA: smoke run by 23:00 PT.

jordan: Autoscale policy I'll apply for rehearsal: min_replicas=2, max_replicas=20, scale_window=30s, cpu_threshold=65%. Will also set fallback to cpu-only variant if GPU pool is saturated.

elena_r: Alerts I'll add: 95th_latency > 400ms, error_rate > 1%, throttled_tokens > 0.5%. Also wiring an eval probe against our canonical prompt set to track quality drift during spike. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pegasus-rollback

priya.k: Also: capture enablement feedback — customer asked for clearer token budgeting examples and guidance on warmup cadence. Can someone take notes and add to the onboarding doc?

sam.w: I'll take notes and add a short "token budget & warmup" section to the onboarding doc after the rehearsal.

priya.k: Perfect. If anything escalates, follow the pegagus-rollback runbook and ping @escalations. Thanks everyone — will post a final checklist after the smoke run.
